subject: Captured Bus-to-Stereo Send completion and owned cancellation from Tracks focus
question: Can a captured singleton Bus-to-Stereo Send goal check its native input prerequisites, complete or compensate its own change, and restore the prepared Tracks state?

reverify.command: Prepare a stopped disposable four-track/nine-strip project. Select a source with physical Input 1, main Stereo output and exactly one occupied Bus 1 Send in Post Fader mode, raw level zero and bypass off; retain a separate existing Bus 1 receiver. Start with Tracks-container focus and the fully visible leftmost viewport. Capture selection/tracks/strips/associations/routing through inspect_session. Plan one confirmed canonical Send output goal with the issued project/track references and observed ordinal 1. Check wrong-target planning and wrong-digest application without changing the independent native UI. Apply the valid plan within its existing lifetime. For cancellation, observe a newly verified child and that exact key still in progress before cancelling it. Inspect compensation, terminal journal and same-key replay. In a separate execution, let the canonical goal complete, verify its cached completed-key replay and independently inspect the actual Send change. Freshly capture the changed source and use a separately preflighted generic Stereo-to-Bus 1 singleton to return the fixture. Compare complete independent native UI states at each terminal checkpoint.
reverify.expected: Cancellation reports one verified forward and one verified owned inverse, fullyCompensated and a cancelled journal, with checked bus:1 restored. Normal canonical completion reports A/completed/verified and independently checked stereo_output. Its distinct generic return reports A/completed/verified and checked bus:1; that fresh request is not a canonical return or the preceding request's owned inverse. Same-key replay returns retained results. The complete terminal AX state equals the prepared Tracks baseline. Existing custody, protected-state, deadline and ambiguity refusals remain intact.

method: Actual registered public MCP calls against a source-attested executable, event-bound cancellation through public trace/journal observations, and independent native AX comparisons. The initial host locale is English; the explicitly labelled Korean cases reuse the same executable after an app-specific locale relaunch. Screenshots separately corroborate the visible viewport and routing controls. Selected response fields are attached without private project paths or opaque request/reference/trace tokens.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This measures native source custody, action/readback, compensation, replay and UI restoration. It makes no assertion about canonical label vocabulary or translations.

conclusion: The bounded captured Bus-to-Stereo singleton completes and compensates its owned native effect from the prepared Tracks entry. A separate generic request returns a normally completed change. This does not qualify arbitrary canonical Stereo-to-Bus goals or whole routing/session repair.
limits: One stopped four-track/nine-strip fixture in English and Korean; hidden/shared strips, arbitrary topology, other locales, cold acquisition and Logic 12.4 are unqualified.

This fully visible leftmost viewport does not qualify automatic restoration of arbitrary scrolled/offscreen layouts. The separate opt-in native Scroll To test was skipped, not promoted to native evidence.

The earlier source checkpoint 7b58b901 refused checked input acquisition before writing with a stopped Help guard. Its immutable recording is retained separately; the source-attested abef1bcb runs establish the repaired bounded profile.

An initial normal-completion attempt waited 117 seconds between planning and application and was refused without writing. That retained plan-expiry failure is not a product regression or a passing normal execution; no lifetime or deadline was extended.

An initial Korean caller had no interactive stdin and stopped before refresh with independent_continuation_missing. Its raw recording is retained; the separate PTY-backed execution, not that launch failure, supplies the Korean cancellation evidence.
Native receiver-conflict injection, mixed-Saga atomicity, namespace/allocation and full R1-R4/F1-F5 acceptance are not established.

Raw recordings contain private project identities and are not published. Attached excerpts and hashes are not a headless native replay or independent per-AX-action instrumentation. Pixel equality is not claimed.
